title: In-Community Transfer Settings by Lease Term Agreement Program
content:
A resident may move to another apartment home in the same community by a transfer. The Resident Services Center reads the following settings from the program of the resident's current Lease Term Agreement.

| Term program | Transfer allowed | Months of the term elapsed before signing | Transfer fee (dollars) | Fee waived for an upsize | Shortest new term (months) | Notice (calendar days from request to move date) | Transfers per trailing 365 days | No past-due balance required |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Month-to-Month Agreement | No | 0 | 0.00 | No | 0 | 30 | 0 | Yes |
| Short-Term Lease (3-5 Months) | No | 0 | 0.00 | No | 0 | 30 | 0 | Yes |
| Flexible Lease (6-9 Months) | Yes | 3 | 350.00 | No | 6 | 30 | 1 | Yes |
| Standard Lease (10-12 Months) | Yes | 6 | 400.00 | Yes | 10 | 30 | 1 | Yes |
| Extended Lease (13-15 Months) | Yes | 6 | 500.00 | Yes | 10 | 30 | 1 | Yes |
| Long-Term Lease (16-24 Months) | Yes | 6 | 500.00 | Yes | 10 | 30 | 2 | Yes |

## Settings explained

- **Upsize waiver.** Where the column shows Yes, the transfer fee is waived when the destination floor plan ranks above the current one.
- **Shortest new term.** The minimum length of the new term signed with the transfer.
- **Transfers per trailing 365 days.** The number of transfers that may be signed on the lease within the trailing 365 days.

## Illustration (hypothetical)

A resident on a Standard Lease (10-12 Months) term may sign a transfer once 6 months of the term have elapsed, gives 30 calendar days between the request and the move date, signs a new term of at least 10 months and pays 400.00 dollars unless the destination floor plan ranks above the current one. On a Month-to-Month Agreement no transfer may be requested.
